SUPERSEDED: This result's +0.221 'aot BEATS raw sgt' verdict is RETRACTED. It was inflated by (1) rubric leakage — the reasoning-trace task's rubric described aot's own premise/reasoning/hypothesis/verification DAG, so the aot arm got a vocabulary bonus that carried the whole margin (+0.451 of it), and (2) asymmetric token accounting — the aot arm's traceTokens came from `export --token-count` (~2000) while the baseline was charged char/4 of raw JSON, undercounting aot's real read-cost. run-integration-v2.json fixes both (decontaminated rubrics, symmetric ceil(chars/4) both arms, seeded blind judge, joint re-judging) with IDENTICAL weights, and finds margin -0.142: raw sgt BEATS the aot interleaving. Kept on disk as the honest record of a caught-and-corrected inflated result. See run-integration-v2.json.
unitUnderTest: THE aot<->sgt INTEGRATION as a unit (not aot-strategy-in-general)
suite: 3 corpus-grounded retrieval tasks (rate-limit, reasoning-trace, progressive-disclosure) over the real 8733-skill sgt corpus

arms.aot: aot+sgt INTERLEAVED: sgt route -> advise -> expand (progressive disclosure) -> judge (verified selection) -> trace, answer grounded ONLY in disclosed excerpt
arms.baseline: RAW sgt retrieval: graph search / route plan / context pack — NO aot layer, no reasoning graph, no verification

mutationRounds.analysis: Expanding the top-2 advised hypotheses yielded margin 0.1573, which is below the prior best (0.2212) and only marginally above the noise floor (0.1489), so the extra disclosure did not reliably improve grounding — it mostly added token cost without clearing the bar. The two-expansion path likely diluted the answer with a weaker second hypothesis, blurring the signal from the single strong top-1 expansion rather than reinforcing it.

The judge-and-prune mutation scored margin 0.1751 — clearing the noise floor (0.1348) but falling short of the prior best (0.2212), so it did not clear and offers no net gain. Hard-dropping refuted hypotheses and citing only --supports likely discarded useful contrastive context, so the selection filter over-pruned rather than sharpening the trace.

recommendations.recommendation: Instead of expanding a fixed top-2, gate the second expansion on the advisor's confidence gap: only expand the runner-up when its score is within a small delta of top-1, so borderline cases get disclosure while clear-winner cases keep the cheaper, higher-margin single expansion.

Soften the prune: keep the per-hypothesis judging but retain refuted hypotheses as explicit counter-evidence in the trace (cite them as --refutes rather than deleting), so the aot expansion feeds sgt both supported and contrastive context instead of a support-only subset.

finalStrategy: S0 (route->advise->expand->judge->trace) — both mutations discarded; S0 remains best
verdict: The aot<->sgt interleaving BEATS raw sgt retrieval (clears noise floor) — the integration adds measurable value
agentErrorNote: 2 of 49 agents hit the StructuredOutput retry cap (transient); surviving replicates >=2 per arm/task, verdict robust to their loss
